findings.title: Catalog proof can be downgraded to conventional by clearing mutable discriminators
findings.evidence: Applied one CN and one TW fixture, then set name/evidence/candidate decision_kind=conventional and generation_rule_version=none, removed primary_orthographic payload, and changed owner canonical_name. Both strict API queries still returned total=1/display=劉元赫; both coverage reports counted conventional=1. Immutable creation-ledger reference_kind sets omit catalog_chinese_default.
findings.required_fix: Recognize catalog_chinese_default in both immutable creation-ledger checks and add CN/TW masked-target regression.
findings.resolution: Both immutable creation-ledger reference-kind sets now include catalog_chinese_default; parameterized CN/TW strict-reader and coverage regression rejects masked targets.

findings.title: Normal authoritative_pages append invalidates all catalog names
findings.evidence: New reader reuses full KifuPlayer row comparison, including authoritative_pages, while routine page sync appends only those metadata. Added implementation test already confirms any page metadata change makes source_live false; persisted_name_eligible uses that same check.
findings.required_fix: Keep complete owner row CAS in dry-run/apply. Only persisted reader may ignore authoritative_pages drift, while requiring owner existence and exact id/canonical_name/created_at. This corrects the earlier policy schema overconstraint at root request.
findings.resolution: Default source_live retains full-row equality; only persisted_name_eligible opts in to authoritative_pages drift, comparing exact id/canonical_name/created_at and requiring current owner. CN/TW API survives page append; identity drift loses coverage; pre-apply metadata drift blocks.

deployment_requirement: Ship updated validator and persisted reader to active API runtime and rebuildable container image before importing catalog candidates. Dockerfile.web copies source; compose binds assets only. No deployment or DB access performed.
scope_limitations: No product changes, git mutation, production/TEST database access, or child agents.
Review is code approval only, not native candidate/source approval or deployment authorization.
Previously reported 9 legacy regex-message test failures were not rerun or made a gate.

contract_clarifications.source_identity: source_lang=zh; source_script=Han; output CN exact preservation or TW finite mapping only
contract_clarifications.root_requested_metadata_refinement: Full owner preimage for dry-run/apply; persisted reader may ignore authoritative_pages changes and must match existing id/canonical_name/created_at. Recorded in final plan.
contract_clarifications.source_approval_independence: Anchor, rule and frozen batch approvals, plus final reviewer/binder independence retained. Review does not approve source/native candidates.
